words.definition: to come to an end and no longer be valid
words.example: Your gym membership will expire at the end of this month.
words.exampleTranslation: 你的健身房會員資格將在這個月底到期。

words.definition: a cardboard or digital container used to hold and organize documents
words.example: Save the signed contract in the shared client folder.
words.exampleTranslation: 把簽好的合約存進共用的客戶資料夾裡。

words.definition: a copy of a document made using a photocopier
words.example: Make a photocopy of your ID before submitting the application.
words.exampleTranslation: 提交申請前請先影印一份身分證件。

words.definition: to repair and improve a building so it is in good condition again
words.example: The company plans to renovate the reception area next spring.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司計劃明年春天翻新接待區。

words.definition: bright with sunlight; having a lot of sunshine
words.example: The forecast predicts a sunny weekend for the outdoor event.
words.exampleTranslation: 預報顯示這場戶外活動的週末會是晴天。

words.definition: a chart or app showing the days, weeks, and months of a year
words.example: Please add the client call to your calendar for Thursday.
words.exampleTranslation: 請把跟客戶的通話加進你星期四的行事曆。

words.definition: money or goods given to help a person or cause
words.example: The company matches every employee donation to the charity drive.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司會為每一筆員工捐款提供相同金額的配捐。

words.definition: opinions or reactions given about a product, performance, or idea
words.example: We'd appreciate your feedback on the new customer service process.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們很希望能得到你對新客服流程的回饋意見。

words.definition: in a short time; soon
words.example: The manager will join the call shortly after the introductions.
words.exampleTranslation: 自我介紹結束後，經理很快就會加入這通電話。

words.definition: a small amount of food eaten between meals
words.example: There are snacks and coffee available during the break.
words.exampleTranslation: 休息時間有提供點心和咖啡。

words.definition: a large building used for storing goods
words.example: The new warehouse can hold twice as much inventory.
words.exampleTranslation: 這座新倉庫的存貨容量是原本的兩倍。

words.definition: a machine that makes copies of documents
words.example: The copier on the third floor is out of paper again.
words.exampleTranslation: 三樓的影印機又沒紙了。

words.definition: a person or company that supplies a service or product
words.example: We switched to a new internet provider to lower monthly costs.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們換了新的網路供應商來降低每月費用。

words.definition: a drink, especially one other than water
words.example: Complimentary beverages are available at the hotel lounge all day.
words.exampleTranslation: 飯店的交誼廳整天都有提供免費飲料。

words.definition: feeling a need or desire to eat
words.example: Let's break for lunch before everyone gets too hungry.
words.exampleTranslation: 在大家太餓之前，我們先休息去吃午餐吧。

words.definition: a careful examination to check the condition or quality of something
words.example: The factory passed its annual safety inspection.
words.exampleTranslation: 這間工廠通過了年度安全檢查。

words.definition: a person who receives something
words.example: Make sure the recipient's address is correct before mailing the package.
words.exampleTranslation: 寄出包裹前請確認收件人地址正確。

words.definition: a passage between rows of seats or shelves
words.example: He prefers an aisle seat so he can stretch his legs.
words.exampleTranslation: 他偏好走道座位，這樣才能伸展雙腿。

words.definition: to examine something closely to check its condition or quality
words.example: A technician will inspect the equipment before it ships out.
words.exampleTranslation: 設備出貨前會有技師進行檢查。

words.definition: a skilled worker who repairs and maintains machines, especially vehicles
words.example: The company van is at the mechanic's for its regular checkup.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司的貨車正在技工那裡做定期檢查。
